versus

 Rohini.

 Adv. for R-2 through V.C.
 R-2 through V.C.
 CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMIT MAHAJAN  ORDER % 30.05.2025 CRL.M.A. 17604/2025 (exemption)
1. Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

The petitioner seeks quashing of FIR No.69/2023 dated 03.02.2023 under Section 498A/406/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act,
registered at Police Station North Rohini on the ground that the parties have settled the dispute.
4. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is carrying the balance settlement amount of 7,00,000/-.
This is a digitally signed order.

Neither the complainant nor her counsel is present in the Court to accept the said amount.
